caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, light-colored background. The object is a goblet-shaped container made from a brownish material, possibly clay or metal, with a series of vertical, rounded grooves decorating its surface. The vessel stands on a short, broad pedestal base. The top of the container is covered with a rough, flat piece of wood that is slightly tilted and uneven, leaving a small gap through which the dark interior of the vessel is partially visible. The colors used are earth tones, predominantly shades of brown and ochre, giving the object a worn and aged appearance. Two small signatures appear to the lower right of the base.
title: Baptismal Font
